document.title: Interface module IM151-3 PN (6ES7151-3AA23-0AB0)
document.pages: 3 (scope), 7-8 (rail coupling/two-port switch), 12-15 (pin/block diagrams, ratings, front view), 23 (X1P1/X1P2 configuration); printed and PDF numbering coincide

modelingNotes: Field-interface model of exact 6ES7151-3AA23-0AB0 IM151-3 PN ST, with its depicted supply connector and two RJ45 sockets. No separately ordered ET 200S terminal-module clamps are transferred. Manual A5E01638907-04, 08/2010, applies from firmware V7.0; installed hardware/firmware remains unknown.

X1.P1 and X1.P2 are authoring namespaces for manufacturer X1P1/X1P2 (manual p.23), shown under X1 PROFINET P1/P2 on the front view. Dotted terminal keys preserve each socket pin number. SHIELD is an alias for depicted socket shielding, not pin 9 or a PE clamp. These are device mating contacts; no cable-plug termination endpoints are invented.

Logical ports X1.P1/X1.P2 expose the two RJ45 sockets as Ethernet communication endpoints. Physical connectorPorts X1.P1.CONTACTS/X1.P2.CONTACTS retain each socket pin inventory. CONTACTS is an authoring suffix required because the compiler rejects a key declared in both port collections (E207); it is not a printed marking. Each logical port and corresponding pin map describe the same socket, not separate connectable hardware. PROFINET protocol belongs on authored communication relations; logical links do not join physical nets. Do not author independent cables to both representations of one socket.

Pp.8,13,23 document an integrated two-port switch and separately configurable X1P1/X1P2 ports. The transmission procedure is 100BASE-TX; PROFINET IO is 100 Mbit/s full duplex and Ethernet services also support 10 Mbit/s. Autonegotiation and autocrossing are supported. No permanent inter-port wire or fixed RJ45 signal continuity is asserted through the active switch.

Table 1-1 p.12 identifies 1L+/1M as the 24 V DC supply and 2L+/2M as loop-through. Represent the two factory feed paths with explicit project jumpers 1L+-2L+ and 1M-2M. These are not field jumper installation instructions. Function and connector metadata never join nets. Shared supply policy accommodates fixture jumpers and field wiring without asserting clamp conductor count or ampacity.

1L+ and 1M are required because this active IM needs its rated 24 V DC supply and return; each can be connected through its documented loop-through path. 2L+ and 2M are not independently required. Neither P1 nor P2 is universally required individually: network use is topology-dependent and p.8 supports port disabling. This schema cannot express an at-least-one-of-two communication requirement; a working PROFINET application must establish the intended communication path.

P.7 explicitly documents an RC combination between supply reference M and the rail (protective conductor), enabling an earth-free configuration. It is not a direct fixed wire and is not modeled as a jumper. The exact physical rail-contact/RC endpoint inventory remains unenumerated. P.14 documents Ethernet-to-electronics galvanic isolation, and no isolation between electronics and either supply or rear-panel bus; these are functional ratings, not a detailed terminal continuity map.

RJ45 pins 4,5,7,8 are GND in Table 1-1. The table does not specify a complete pin-to-pin, socket-shell, rail or M continuity matrix; matching GND names alone are not converted into fixed links. Omitted paths do not prove physical isolation. Backplane and MMC contacts also remain unenumerated, so connectionCoverage is partial.

Figure 1-1 p.13 uses unexplained supply-side numbers 2(P1),6(P1),3(P2),7(P2), unlike Table 1-1 and the front view. They are not used as RJ45 mappings or additional supply legends. The supply loop-through claims rely on Table 1-1; the block diagram shows duplicate feed branches without resolving that labeling discrepancy.

Rated supply is 24 V DC. P.14 gives approximately 200 mA input consumption and 3.3 W dissipation, reverse-polarity protection, minimum 20 ms power-failure bypass, permitted rail potential difference 75 V DC/60 V AC and insulation-test voltage 500 V DC. These do not establish loop-through ampacity, external bond adequacy or an allowable supply range.

connectionCoverage.notes: 22 field-interface terminals: 1L+/1M with 2L+/2M loop-through and both RJ45 sockets, each with pins 1-8 and shielding. Two logical Ethernet ports with separately named physical pin-map aliases add communication semantics, not terminals. Backplane/MMC contacts and physical rail/RC endpoints remain unenumerated; detailed GND/shield/rail continuity is not modeled. Known M-to-rail RC coupling and documented Ethernet isolation are retained in notes.

X1.P1.description: PROFINET IO X1 port P1 (manufacturer X1P1); integrated two-port switch, 100BASE-TX, 100 Mbit/s full duplex for PROFINET IO; 10 Mbit/s Ethernet services also documented. Logical communication endpoint; connector-port pins are inventoried separately.

X1.P2.description: PROFINET IO X1 port P2 (manufacturer X1P2); integrated two-port switch, 100BASE-TX, 100 Mbit/s full duplex for PROFINET IO; 10 Mbit/s Ethernet services also documented. Logical communication endpoint; connector-port pins are inventoried separately.
